name: Join My Homelab
description: Lend spare hardware to the Join My Homelab community cloud. This VM boots your personal image, installs itself and joins the cluster as a node, earning credits for every hour it hosts machines.

notes.text: The image is personal: it is built per account and carries that account's join token. The script asks joinmyhomelab.com for it over SSH (the first connection creates your account); set VM_ISO_URL to skip that, or take the URL from the dashboard.
The host needs nested virtualisation: the node joins without it, but machines on the node will not start.
The node installs itself on first boot, reboots and joins the cluster. Watch the console in Proxmox, then ssh dashboard@joinmyhomelab.com shows it green when it is ready.
